sections.title: Shop
sections.sql: select code,name,country,currency,owner from feed.shops where id=$1

sections.title: Products
sections.sql: select sku,title,price,currency,availability,quantity,observed_at from feed.products where shop_id=$1 and not archived order by sku
sections.note: Fictional values in the demo. Product prices are not software subscription prices.

sections.title: Outstanding work
sections.sql: select title,owner,due,overdue from feed.open_tasks where shop_id=$1 order by due

sections.title: Channel
sections.sql: select name,format,owner from feed.channels where id=$1

sections.title: Saved runs
sections.sql: select r.id,r.counts,r.actor prepared_by,r.created_at,a.actor reviewed_by,a.note from feed.runs r left join feed.approvals a on a.run_id=r.id where r.channel_id=$1 order by r.created_at desc
sections.note: An approval records a named reviewer assertion. It is not a signature or a channel acceptance receipt.

sections.title: Current rules
sections.sql: select name,priority,field,operator,match_value,action,target_field,value,enabled from feed.rules where channel_id=$1 order by priority

sections.title: Open corrections
sections.sql: select title,owner,due,overdue from feed.open_tasks where shop_id=$1 order by due

sections.title: Stock exceptions
sections.sql: select p.sku,p.title,p.availability,p.quantity from feed.products p where p.shop_id=$1 and not p.archived and (p.quantity=0 or p.availability='out_of_stock') order by sku
sections.note: Run the feed check for missing titles, invalid identifiers and export requirements.
